notes.title: Unlock Destiny: FATE Sale & Mimic Plushie Giveaway!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5379840/54425c021d00904d65e02336c1fc70599c546e23.jpg

Join us as we present the FATE Games Sale from November 14th to November 28th! Experience epic savings with a 40% discount on individual FATE games and an exhilarating 50% off on the bundle of all four.

But that's not all—brace yourself for a wave of cuteness! The Mimic Plushie Giveaway, happening concurrently from November 14th to November 30th, offers you the chance to win one of five adorable Mimic Plushies. Winners will be announced on December 1st. For giveaway details, visit https://www.wildtangent.com/promo/giveaway/.


Key Highlights:

FATE Games Discounted:

 40% off on all individual FATE games.
 50% off on the bundle of all four FATE games.


Mimic Plushie Giveaway:

 Enter from November 14th to November 30th on Mimic Giveaway Page
 5 winners announced on December 1st.
 Your destiny and a cozy plushie await! Don't miss out on this chance to save big and add a touch of cuteness to your collection. Choose your FATE now!

notes.title: Exclusive: Bring your Mimic plushie home!
notes.content:
Attention FATE fans! Dive into the thrilling world of the Fate universe with our exclusive Mimic plush. 

This limited-edition, magical chest-inspired collectible captures the dangerous essence of Mimic like never before. Don't miss out on owning a piece of the Fate universe. 

Order here your limited-edition Mimic plush today and experience the enchantment firsthand.

notes.title: Exclusive: Bring your Fate plush home!
notes.content:
To celebrate all fans around the world for their continuous support and enthusiasm towards the game, we partnered with Makeship to bring Fate to life.
We are rarely given choices in life… but this summer, you will have the option to hold Fate in your hands!

From the 15th of July, you can preorder your plushie here: https://www.makeship.com/products/fate-plush

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5379840/d32827405ab206a94fb55ba658da82bc3af7cb3b.jpg

Don't let this little guy scare you and master your destiny! Move fast and get this adorable little bundle of terror now before it's too late!

BONUS:
Every preorder will also receive this exclusive Fate-inspired bedroom artwork in HD.
